text.title: Quality Gates — Matrix and Tool Recommendations
text.summary: The stack-to-gate matrix as a lookup table, and the recommended (not prescriptive) test tools per layer. The git diff is the input; the matrix is the lookup.

section.title: Stack-to-gate matrix
section.p: Quality gates are NOT prescriptive about test frameworks. They ARE prescriptive about which kind of test must exist for which kind of change.

list.item: Backend only → unit tests REQUIRED + API tests REQUIRED. No Playwright. No UI audit.
Backend + Frontend (full-stack feature) → unit tests REQUIRED + API tests REQUIRED + Playwright happy path REQUIRED. UI audit REQUIRED if any visible UI changed.
User-facing flow (any surface where the user takes ordered actions) → Playwright positive AND negative cases REQUIRED per flow. UI audit REQUIRED if web/mobile/TUI.
Frontend only (no backend changes) → unit tests REQUIRED + Playwright pos+neg per flow REQUIRED. No API tests for this feature.
Pure data (migration, ETL, no UI / API contract change) → unit tests REQUIRED + migration tests REQUIRED + reversibility check REQUIRED. No Playwright. No UI audit. No API tests.
Infrastructure / CI / build-system → unit tests on any logic changed + smoke check that build / deploy still produces a working artefact.

example.code: Layer touched | unit | api | playwright happy | playwright pos+neg | ui audit | migration | reversibility | smoke ---------------------|------|-----|------------------|--------------------|-------------------|-----------|---------------|------ Backend only | yes | yes | - | - | - | - | - | - Backend + Frontend | yes | yes | yes | - | if visible change | - | - | - User-facing flow | - | - | - | yes, per flow | if web/mobile/TUI | - | - | - Frontend only | yes | - | - | yes, per flow | - | - | - | - Pure data | yes | - | - | - | - | yes | yes | - Infra / CI / build | logic changed | - | - | - | - | - | - | yes
example.note: Take the union of every row the diff touches. Each gate is then enforced twice: once in readiness.md (human judgement re: applicability) and once in CI (machine actual run).

section.title: Recommended test tools per layer
section.p: The methodology is prescriptive on "must exist", NOT on framework choice. These are recommendations the team can override per language / stack.

list.item: Unit tests (Python) — pytest. (Alt: unittest if pytest is unavailable.)
Unit tests (TypeScript / JavaScript) — vitest or jest.
API tests (Python) — pytest + httpx or DRF APIClient.
API tests (any language) — direct HTTP calls in the unit-test framework.
E2E user-facing — Playwright. (Cypress is an acceptable alternative; Selenium is not.)
Visual regression — Playwright screenshot diff + reg-cli or Chromatic.
Load / perf — k6 or Locust; outside per-feature scope, governed at project-spec/non-functional.md.
A reviewer computing readiness item 5 / 6 applicability, or a subagent's close-out logic deciding whether to run API tests, Playwright, both, or neither, both read the same matrix from the same diff.
Pin which gates apply at new-project setup, before code is written, so the tools in step 3 are already in CI when the first feature lands.
